subject: 1492, Taraskh, 2nd tenday, 3rd day
fact: The events occur on the third day of the second tenday of Taraskh in the year 1492; this is the canonical temporal anchor for the prison narrative.
source_quote: 3rd day of the 2nd tenday of Taraskh, 1492

subject: 3rd day of the 2nd tenday of Taraskh, 1492
fact: The events of the prison exploration begin on the 3rd day of the 2nd tenday of Taraskh, 1492.
source_quote: 3rd day of the 2nd tenday of Taraskh, 1492

subject: 4th day of the 2nd Tenday of Taraskh
fact: The next day, Gyrgum returns to the kitchen with six Drow soldiers present.
source_quote: 4th day of the 2nd Tenday of Taraskh... The next day, Gyrgum goes to the kitchen again. This time, six Drow soldiers are present.

subject: 4th day of the 2nd Tenday of Taraskh
fact: This is the documented date on which Gyrgum’s cooking performance draws drow soldiers, Topsy and Turvy steal knives, and the prisoner collective’s coordination intensifies; it marks a pivotal escalation in the timeline of resistance.
source_quote: ## 4th day of the 2nd Tenday of Taraskh

subject: before assigned tasks

subject: basket dropping

subject: Buppido
fact: Buppido projects his mind: “The Divine plan says we must collaborate and share information.”
source_quote: It’s then that Buppido speaks, or instead projects his mind, “The Divine plan says we must collaborate and share information.”

subject: Buppido
fact: Buppido says, “The divine plan requires that you create a distraction while I escape.”
source_quote: After sharing the information, Buppido says, “The divine plan requires that you create a distraction while I escape.”

subject: Buppido
fact: Buppido says, “You have pledged your swords and your spells! And your lives.”
source_quote: Buppido looks surprised, “We?” Thorin, who also picked up on the derro’s insanity, says, “Well, how else will we protect you so that you can fulfill the divine plan?” The derro stares at Gyrgum and says, “You are quite right. You have pledged your swords and your spells! And your lives.”

subject: Buppido accepts group escape
fact: Buppido says, “You have pledged your swords and your spells! And your lives.”
source_quote: You have pledged your swords and your spells! And your lives.

subject: Buppido proposing escape to Gracklstugh
fact: Buppido declares that the escape destination is Gracklstugh, his homeland.
source_quote: Buppido smiles, “To Gracklstugh, my homeland!”

subject: Buppido’s Divine Escape Plan
fact: Buppido declares a 'divine plan' requiring a distraction to enable his escape; Thorin redefines it as a collective escape, convincing Buppido that the prisoners have pledged their lives to him; this marks a turning point where delusion becomes a catalyst for unified action.
source_quote: Buppido: 'The divine plan requires that you create a distraction while I escape.' ... Thorin: 'We escape?' ... Buppido: 'We?'

subject: Buppido's escape plan
fact: Buppido says, “The divine plan requires that you create a distraction while I escape.”
source_quote: Buppido says, “The divine plan requires that you create a distraction while I escape.”

subject: Buppido's vague plan
fact: Buppido says, “In due time.” when asked about the plan.
source_quote: Buppido, like any mysterious god or charlatan masquerading as a god, would say, “In due time.”

subject: cooking distraction suggestion
fact: Shuushar suggests cooking as a better distraction than talking.
source_quote: Can you cook? That would be a better distraction.

subject: cooking performance sequence
fact: Gyrgum performs his cooking show on the 3rd day and again on the 4th day.
source_quote: As the lunch progresses... The next day, Gyrgum goes to the kitchen again.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz notes that Thorin has a better job than he does.
source_quote: Daz notes that Thorin has a better job.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz notes that the group mind created by Stool’s spores allows coordination without discovery.
source_quote: Daz notes that this allows them to coordinate any plans without being discovered.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz notices Zalthir and thinks the monk will have unpleasant fun cleaning up after he comes up.
source_quote: Daz notices Zalthir and thinks the monk will have some unpleasant fun cleaning up after he comes up.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz notices that the lake is unusually clean despite the filth being dumped into it.
source_quote: Daz, Stool, and Sarith walk to the edge of the lake and notice that it is pretty clean, which is odd given the amount of filth being deposited.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz remembers that Sethir said there is a grey ooze in the pool, and that’s how the waste gets processed.
source_quote: Right, Sethir said there is a grey ooze in the pool. That’s how the waste gets processed.

subject: deal acceptance
fact: The dwarf's deal is accepted.
source_quote: Your deal is accepted.

subject: drow behavior
fact: Other Drow would taunt if they had the characters' stuff.
source_quote: And if any other Drow had our stuff, they would taunt us.

subject: drow leadership
fact: The Drow leader probably keeps all the loot for herself.
source_quote: The Drow leader probably keeps all the loot for herself.

subject: Drow soldiers ignore theft
fact: The Drow soldiers ignore Topsy and Turvy stealing knives because they are delighted by the performance.
source_quote: The drow soldiers, delighted at this entertainment, ignore the two deep gnomes who make off with a knife.

subject: Elspeth pocketing comb
fact: Elspeth finds and pockets a comb after noticing Zalthir pocket the paper.
source_quote: He notices that Elspeth sees him pocket the paper. He notices that she finds a comb. She pockets the comb.

subject: escape route suggestion
fact: Jorlan suggests using the waterfall or spiderwebs to escape.
source_quote: Use the waterfall to slide down, or jump into the spiderwebs and then jump into the pools of water.

subject: food theft distraction plan
fact: Topsy and Turvy ask Gyrgum to create a distraction so they can steal food.
source_quote: The twins wonder if you could create a distraction by talking to the drow while they steal some food?

subject: group mind coordination
fact: The group mind allows prisoners to coordinate plans without being discovered.
source_quote: This allows them to coordinate any plans without being discovered.

subject: Group Mind Formation in the Prison Cell
fact: Jimjar’s spores have created a shared group mind among all prisoners in the cell, enabling silent, undetectable coordination of plans; this development transforms the prison from a place of isolation into a covert network of resistance.
source_quote: Daz notes that this allows them to coordinate any plans without being discovered.

subject: Guldor taking knife
fact: Guldor takes the knife from Gyrgum after noticing his attempt to steal it.
source_quote: Guldor notices and Grygum explains that he is just trying to sharpen the knife. Guldor takes the knife and says a bunch of words whose intent is quite clear.

subject: Gyrgum
fact: Gyrgum guesses that Topsy and Turvy might be better placed to steal a knife after seeing them steal food.
source_quote: Seeing how they successfully stole food, he guesses they might be better placed to steal a knife.

subject: Gyrgum
fact: Gyrgum notices that the Kuo-Toan Shuushar the Awakened tells him to relax.
source_quote: The Kuo-Toan Shuushar the Awakened notices and tells him to relax

subject: Gyrgum
fact: Gyrgum realizes he’s not a great cook and that many ingredients are unfamiliar, but he can put on a great show.
source_quote: he realizes that he’s not a great cook and that many ingredients are unfamiliar, but he can put on a great show.

subject: Gyrgum
fact: Gyrgum realizes that Shuushar has left out many details in his translations.
source_quote: Grygum again realizes that Shuushar has left out many details.

subject: Gyrgum
fact: Gyrgum tries to steal a knife and explains he is just trying to sharpen it.
source_quote: Grygum notices a knife and tries to steal it. Guldor notices and Grygum explains that he is just trying to sharpen the knife.

subject: Gyrgum
fact: Gyrgum wonders how much time has passed.
source_quote: How much time has passed?” he wonders.

subject: Gyrgum cooks with flair
fact: Gyrgum tosses ingredients into the air, moves like a dancer, and hums a tune while cooking.
source_quote: As Gyrgum, with theatrical flair, tosses ingredients into the air, moves like a dancer, and hums a tune

subject: Gyrgum entering cave
fact: Gyrgum enters a cave as the basket comes up.
source_quote: As the basket comes up, he notices Grygum entering a cave.

subject: Gyrgum feigns inferiority
fact: Gyrgum tells the Drow, “Yes, I am the inferior race.”
source_quote: Grygum smiles at the Drow, “Yes, I am the inferior race.”

subject: Ilvara's command
fact: Ilvara commands prisoners not to spill water, touch anything, and to fill her bath.
source_quote: “This is my quarters. I am the high priestess of Lolth and commander. Do not spill any water, do not touch anything, and fill my bath.”

subject: Ilvara's pep talk phrase
fact: Ilvara ends her pep talks with, 'Accept your fate, learn to obey, and you may survive.'
source_quote: Every time, she would end her pep talks with the phrase - ‘Accept your fate, learn to obey, and you may survive.’

subject: Ilvara threatens Prince Derendil
fact: Ilvara pulls a knife and explains in detail how she will treat Prince Derendil if he disobeys.
source_quote: when Prince Derendil objects to being a chamber enslaved person, Ilvara pulls a knife and points at him and explains in excruciating detail how she will treat him if he doesn’t bring the water.

subject: Jimjar proposing betting on escape route
fact: Jimjar proposes a bet on which escape route the new prisoners will choose.
source_quote: Jimjar adds, “Who wants to bet on which path the new guys will want to go? Will they go with the myconid kid? The enlightened kuo-toan? The Destiny Weilding Derro? Or trust the two deep gnomes?”

subject: Jorlan offering escape plan
fact: Jorlan offers to leave the prison door open and create a distraction so the prisoners can grab weapons and flee.
source_quote: I will leave the door to the prison open, create a distraction. The path to the armory will be unguarded. Grab the weapons and flee.

subject: Jorlan's escape plan
fact: Jorlan says he will leave the prison door open and create a distraction so they can grab weapons and flee.
source_quote: I will leave the door to the prison open, create a distraction. The path to the armory will be unguarded. Grab the weapons and flee.

subject: knife confiscated
fact: Guldor takes the knife from Gyrgum and warns him of consequences.
source_quote: Guldor takes the knife and says a bunch of words whose intent is quite clear.

subject: Knife Theft by Topsy and Turvy
fact: Topsy and Turvy, deep gnomes, successfully stole several knives from six drow soldiers during Gyrgum’s cooking performance; the soldiers were so entertained they ignored the theft, revealing a dangerous lapse in security and an opportunity for rebellion.
source_quote: Topsy and Turvy steal several knives. The drow soldiers, delighted at this entertainment, ignore the two deep gnomes who make off with a knife.

subject: knife theft during cooking
fact: Topsy and Turvy steal several knives while Gyrgum performs his cooking show.
source_quote: Topsy and Turvy steal several knives.

subject: prisoner awakening
fact: At least one or more of the prisoners wakes in a cold sweat from nightmares after every rest.
source_quote: At least one or more of the prisoners wakes in a cold sweat from these nightmares after every rest

subject: question about paying debts
fact: Zalthir asks, “We have no money; how do we pay our debts?”
source_quote: Zalthir asks, “We have no money; how do we pay our debts?”

subject: Shuushar
fact: Shuushar cautions Gyrgum, “If you were to show this cooking to my people, they might imagine a god like you.”
source_quote: Even Shuushar seems excited, although he cautions the orc, “If you were to show this cooking to my people, they might imagine a god like you.”

subject: Shuushar
fact: Shuushar translates every insult the Drow used.
source_quote: And then Shuushar proceeds to translate every insult the drow used.

subject: Shuushar proposing path through Menzoberranzan and Darklake
fact: Shuushar proposes going to Darklake first to visit his people before continuing the escape.
source_quote: Yes, but the direct path is through Menzoberranzan. We will have to go to Darklake first, and we must visit my people to share the enlightenment! From there, the path is good.

subject: sleep disturbance
fact: Everyone’s sleep in the slave pen is troubled and fitful, filled with strange dreams and disturbing images.
source_quote: Everyone’s sleep in the slave pen is troubled and fitful, filled with strange dreams and disturbing images.

subject: sleep in slave pen
fact: Everyone sleeps in the slave pen with troubled and fitful sleep.
source_quote: Everyone’s sleep in the slave pen is troubled and fitful, filled with strange dreams and disturbing images.

subject: sleep in slave pen
fact: Everyone’s sleep in the slave pen is troubled and fitful, filled with strange dreams and disturbing images. Dark shadows seem to move and reach out toward them as the characters wander lost through endless mazes of tunnels. Oily tentacles slide to brush up against them while a great buzzing and howling rises in the distance. Suppurating wounds burst open in clouds of spores or crawling masses of maggots or insects. At least one or more of the prisoners wakes in a cold sweat from these nightmares after every rest, feeling as though something is out there in the dark depths — something far worse than the drow.
source_quote: Everyone’s sleep in the slave pen is troubled and fitful, filled with strange dreams and disturbing images. Dark shadows seem to move and reach out toward them as the characters wander lost through endless mazes of tunnels. Oily tentacles slide to brush up against them while a great buzzing and howling rises in the distance. Suppurating wounds burst open in clouds of spores or crawling masses of maggots or insects. At least one or more of the prisoners wakes in a cold sweat from these nightmares after every rest, feeling as though something is out there in the dark depths — something far worse than the drow.

subject: spore-based group conversation
fact: Thorin connects to friends via spores to ask if Jorlan is an entrapment.
source_quote: Thorin connected to his friends via the spores and asked, “How do we know that he isn’t here to entrap us?”

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin asks via spores if Jorlan is trying to entrap them.
source_quote: Thorin connected to his friends via the spores and asked, “How do we know that he isn’t here to entrap us?”

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin is satisfied with Jorlan’s explanation and asks, “What’s the plan?”
source_quote: Thorin is satisfied. “What’s the plan?”

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin notices Zalthir walking by while filling his bucket.
source_quote: As he fills his bucket, he notices Zalthir walking by.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin notices that if he were to jump into the waterfall, he could land safely into the pool below.
source_quote: He notices that if he were to jump into the waterfall, he could quite easily land safely into the pool of water below.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin realizes there is something manic about Ilvara.
source_quote: As Thorin stares at Ilvara some more, he realizes there is something manic about her.

subject: Thorin considers jumping into waterfall
fact: Thorin considers jumping into the waterfall to land safely in the pool below.
source_quote: he could quite easily land safely into the pool of water below.

subject: Topsy and Turvy stealing knives
fact: Topsy and Turvy steal several knives during Gyrgum’s cooking show while the Drow are distracted.
source_quote: As Gyrgum, with theatrical flair, tosses ingredients into the air, moves like a dancer, and hums a tune, Topsy and Turvy steal several knives.

subject: travel to Sloobludop
fact: Sloobludop is approximately eight days away via the Darklake.
source_quote: the town of Sloopdopblop is just eight days away

subject: trust dynamics
fact: People tend to distrust outsiders and view them as a resource to be used.
source_quote: People tend to distrust outsiders and view them as a resource to be used.

subject: water-carrying assignment
fact: Ront and Prince Derendil are assigned to carry water.
source_quote: They will be carrying water.

subject: winch operation frequency
fact: The basket is lowered and raised multiple times during the day, as prisoners repeatedly use it.
source_quote: Wanna get in on some juicy action on how many times they’ll do this?

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir asks, “We have no money; how do we pay our debts?”
source_quote: Zalthir asks, “We have no money; how do we pay our debts?”

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir noticed that the Drow outpost was 100’ in the sky.
source_quote: The first thing that Zalthir noticed was that the Drow outpost was 100’ in the sky.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir notices Grygum entering a cave.
source_quote: As the basket comes up, he notices Grygum entering a cave.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir notices a piece of paper with names of people who owe favors and pockets it.
source_quote: As the basket bounces, Zalthir notices a piece of paper with some names of people who owe a favor to the person who has the paper. It’s unclear where, which city, what favor, and why. But he pockets the paper.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir notices a spider web below which is a pool of water.
source_quote: He looks a little bit more carefully and notices a spider web. Below the spider’s web, he notices a pool of water.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir notices a stalactite across from his prison cell with a door and two bored Drow beyond it.
source_quote: Across from his prison cell is a stalactite. There is a door, and two very bored Drow are past the door.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir notices that Elspeth finds a comb and pockets it.
source_quote: He notices that she finds a comb. She pockets the comb.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir notices that Elspeth sees him pocket the paper.
source_quote: He notices that Elspeth sees him pocket the paper.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir takes a small piece of rope to test its resistance later.
source_quote: He takes a small piece of rope to test its resistance later.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir uses cleaning the basket to examine how to damage the winch.
source_quote: This time, though, he uses the cleaning to examine how he can damage the winch to aid their escape.

subject: Zalthir asking about paying debts
fact: Zalthir asks how the group will pay their debts since they have no money.
source_quote: Zalthir asks, “We have no money; how do we pay our debts?”

subject: Zalthir examines winch for escape
fact: Zalthir uses cleaning to examine how to damage the winch for escape.
source_quote: he uses the cleaning to examine how he can damage the winch to aid their escape.

subject: Zalthir examining winch
fact: Zalthir uses cleaning duties to examine the winch’s spider silk and gears for escape opportunities.
source_quote: This time, though, he uses the cleaning to examine how he can damage the winch to aid their escape. The two things that attract his attention are using spider silk to hold the basket and the winch and gears that the spider silk goes through.

subject: Zalthir pocketing paper
fact: Zalthir pockets a piece of paper with names of debtors while cleaning the basket.
source_quote: As the basket bounces, Zalthir notices a piece of paper with some names of people who owe a favor to the person who has the paper. It’s unclear where, which city, what favor, and why. But he pockets the paper.

subject: Zalthir taking rope sample
fact: Zalthir takes a small piece of rope to test its resistance later.
source_quote: He takes a small piece of rope to test its resistance later.

subject: deep gnomes
fact: Deep gnomes are present as prisoners Topsy and Turvy, who steal knives during Gyrgum’s cooking.
source_quote: Topsy and Turvy whisper to each other... Topsy and Turvy steal several knives.

subject: Deep gnomes
fact: Deep gnomes, represented by Topsy and Shuushar, are known for their knowledge of Underdark routes and their desire to share enlightenment. They advocate for Blingdenstone and Menzoberranzan as escape paths, respectively.
source_quote: Topsy says, “We should go to Blingdenstone. I know there is a way out of the Underdark from there.” Shuushar objects, “Yes, but the direct path is through Menzoberranzan. We will have to go to Darklake first, and we must visit my people to share the enlightenment! From there, the path is good.”

subject: derro
fact: Derro are present as prisoners, including Buppido, who believes he is divine and speaks of a divine plan.
source_quote: Buppido speaks, or instead projects his mind, “The Divine plan says we must collaborate and share information.” ... Daz learns from the cleric that Buppido thinks he is some kind of god, or he is a god.

subject: Derros
fact: Derros, represented by Jimjar, are twisted, greedy dwarves who thrive in chaos and often engage in betting and manipulation. Jimjar wagers on the newcomers’ choices.
source_quote: Jimjar adds, “Who wants to bet on which path the new guys will want to go? Will they go with the myconid kid? The enlightened kuo-toan? The Destiny Weilding Derro? Or trust the two deep gnomes?”

subject: drow
fact: Drow worship Lolth as their spider goddess and operate the outpost as a religious and military center.
source_quote: This place is a shrine to Lolth, the drow’s spider goddess.

subject: Drow
fact: The Drow are an organized group that hoards loot, assigns tasks, and is viewed by prisoners as exploitative and distrustful.
source_quote: The Drow leader probably keeps all the loot for herself. And if any other Drow had our stuff, they would taunt us.

subject: Drow Outpost
fact: The Drow Outpost is a floating facility 100’ in the sky, accessible only by winch and basket systems; it includes a mess hall with zurkhwood tables, a food storage area, and a cave used for gathering; it is staffed by Drow overseers, Quaggoth and Kuo-Toan prisoners, and maintains strict control over labor and punishment.
source_quote: The Drow outpost was 100’ in the sky. A direct drop would be suicidal.

subject: drow warriors
fact: Drow warriors gather in the mess hall cave, which serves as their eating and gathering place.
source_quote: The cave serves as a gathering and eating place for the drow warriors of the outpost.

subject: Ilvara’s polycule
fact: Ilvara’s polycule is a drow power structure that operates through shifting alliances and hierarchies, with members like Jorlan, Shoor, Sethir, and others rising and falling based on loyalty, utility, and physical condition. It controls the slave pen and the prisoners' fate.
source_quote: Sethir says, “That’s Jorlan. He used to be the number one, but after he got hit with acid, his face was disfigured and he lost a finger, Ilvara’s dropped him, and now Shoor is number one.”

subject: kuo-toa
fact: Kuo-toa are present as prisoners, including Shuushar the Awakened, who seeks spiritual balance.
source_quote: The Kuo-Toan Shuushar the Awakened notices and tells him to relax... Shuushar mutters, “I see.”

subject: Kuo-toans
fact: Kuo-toans, represented by Shuushar, are fish-like aberrations who believe in enlightenment and ritual. They insist on visiting their people before proceeding on escape routes.
source_quote: Shuushar objects, “Yes, but the direct path is through Menzoberranzan. We will have to go to Darklake first, and we must visit my people to share the enlightenment! From there, the path is good.”

subject: Lolth-worshippers
fact: Lolth-worshippers are drow who follow the Spider Queen and maintain a rigid, cruel hierarchy. There is no known abolitionist movement among them, and any aid offered to prisoners is assumed to serve their own interests.
source_quote: Prince Derendil explains, “Well we know that there is no abolitionist movement amongst those who worship Lolth. It has to be for his benefit.”

subject: myconid
fact: Myconids are referenced as a potential destination group, with Stool being their representative.
source_quote: Stool objects, “No to the great circle! My people!”

subject: Myconids
fact: The myconids are a fungal race with a communal culture, represented by Stool, who opposes routes that endanger their sacred circle and prioritize their people’s safety.
source_quote: Stool objects, “No to the great circle! My people!”

subject: The Drow of the Priestess’s Tower
fact: The drow of the priestess’s tower are a rigid, hierarchical society devoted to Lolth; they enforce slavery through terror, use spider symbolism in architecture and worship, and maintain control via ritualized violence, surveillance, and psychological domination; their priestess, Ilvara, wields absolute authority.
source_quote: This place is a shrine to Lolth, the drow’s spider goddess. The altar is flanked by a pair of heavy silver candlesticks worth 25 gp each. They hold thick black candles and are unlit.

subject: The Prisoner Collective
fact: The prisoner collective is an ad hoc alliance of diverse races (dwarves, gnomes, orcs, derros, elves) bound by shared captivity; they communicate via spore-induced group minds, coordinated thefts, and shared planning; despite internal differences, they are beginning to unify under the influence of Buppido’s delusions and Thorin’s pragmatic leadership.
source_quote: Jimjar is making more bets. The stool is happy to be talking to everyone and has spread his spores so that everyone in the prison cell is in a group mind. ... Daz notes that this allows them to coordinate any plans without being discovered.

subject: armory
fact: The armory is the target location after the prison door is opened and a distraction is created, where weapons must be seized for escape.
source_quote: Jorlan smiles, “I will leave the door to the prison open, create a distraction. The path to the armory will be unguarded. Grab the weapons and flee.”

subject: Blingdenstone
fact: Blingdenstone is a deep gnome city with a known exit from the Underdark, advocated by Topsy as a safe escape route.
source_quote: Topsy says, “We should go to Blingdenstone. I know there is a way out of the Underdark from there.”

subject: bridge near the waterfall
fact: The bridge near the waterfall has a winch-and-basket device with a spider silk cord, pulleys, and a hand-cranked horizontal spool.
source_quote: As he crosses the bridge near the waterfall... attached to the edge of the barracks platform is a winch-and-basket device consisting of a giant swinging arm that carries a thin cord of strong spider silk. The cord runs through several pulleys from a hand-cranked horizontal spool to a heavy woven basket suspended at the end.

subject: cave
fact: Gyrgum enters a cave as the basket rises.
source_quote: As the basket comes up, he notices Grygum entering a cave.

subject: Darklake
fact: Darklake is a location on the route to Menzoberranzan, required by Shuushar’s plan to visit his kuo-toan people and share enlightenment.
source_quote: Shuushar objects, “Yes, but the direct path is through Menzoberranzan. We will have to go to Darklake first, and we must visit my people to share the enlightenment! From there, the path is good.”

subject: Drow outpost
fact: The Drow outpost is located 100 feet in the sky.
source_quote: the Drow outpost was 100’ in the sky.

subject: Drow outpost elevation
fact: The Drow outpost is 100 feet above the cavern floor.
source_quote: the Drow outpost was 100’ in the sky

subject: Gracklstugh
fact: Gracklstugh is Buppido’s homeland, a dwarven stronghold in the Underdark, proposed as the destination after escape.
source_quote: Buppido smiles, “To Gracklstugh, my homeland!”

subject: Gyrgum prison
fact: The prison door creeks open and a voice commands, 'Wake up.'
source_quote: The prison door creeks open, and a voice rings, “Wake up.”

subject: high priestess tower
fact: Daz notes that Thorin has a better job at the high priestess tower.
source_quote: The next stop is the tower of the high priestess. There, Daz notes that Thorin has a better job.

subject: Ilvara's chamber
fact: Ilvara’s chamber has black web-like mesh walls, woven floor mats, and a divan-like bed.
source_quote: Inside, the walls are hung with black mesh resembling a spider’s web... Thick, woven mats cover the floor, while a low platform is covered with cushions and pillows to make a broad, divan-like bed.

subject: Ilvara’s room
fact: Ilvara’s room contains a chest where the prisoners’ belongings are stored, as observed by Thorin, who assumes the drow leader hoards all loot.
source_quote: Thorin thinks for a moment, “I know where our stuff is. It’s in the chest in Ilvara’s room. The Drow leader probably keeps all the loot for herself. And if any other Drow had our stuff, they would taunt us.”

subject: Ilvara’s room
fact: Ilvara’s room contains a chest where the prisoners’ belongings are stored.
source_quote: It’s in the chest in Ilvara’s room.

subject: Ilvara's shrine
fact: Ilvara’s chamber contains a small shrine to Lolth draped in white silk.
source_quote: One side of the chamber contains a small table and two chairs, while the other holds a small shrine to Lolth draped in white silk.

subject: kitchen
fact: The kitchen is part of the mess hall and contains unfamiliar ingredients that Gyrgum uses for theatrical cooking.
source_quote: He then turns to the kitchen, looks around, and realizes that he’s not a great cook and that many ingredients are unfamiliar

subject: lake
fact: Daz, Stool, and Sarith walk to the edge of the lake and notice it is unusually clean.
source_quote: Daz, Stool, and Sarith walk to the edge of the lake and notice that it is pretty clean, which is odd given the amount of filth being deposited.

subject: lake
fact: The lake is where chamber pots are disposed of and cleaned, and it appears unusually clean despite heavy filth deposition.
source_quote: they take the bucket to the lake, where they dispose of it and clean the filth. ... they notice that it is pretty clean, which is odd given the amount of filth being deposited.

subject: loot storage
fact: The characters' stuff is in the chest in Ilvara’s room.
source_quote: I know where our stuff is. It’s in the chest in Ilvara’s room.

subject: Menzoberranzan
fact: Menzoberranzan is the infamous drow city, which Shuushar insists must be passed through on the way to the surface, requiring a detour to Darklake.
source_quote: Shuushar objects, “Yes, but the direct path is through Menzoberranzan. We will have to go to Darklake first, and we must visit my people to share the enlightenment! From there, the path is good.”

subject: Mess Hall
fact: The Mess Hall is a cave serving as the dining and gathering space for Drow warriors; it contains four circular zurkhwood tables with five chairs each; it has a food preparation and storage area with dried fungi, fruits, cheeses, preserved meat, and clay jars of spices; it is lit by a heavy iron brazier and often serves cold food.
source_quote: The cave serves as a gathering and eating place for the drow warriors of the outpost.

subject: mess hall
fact: The mess hall has a food preparation and storage area with dried and fresh fungi, dried fruits, cheeses, preserved meat, and clay jars of spices.
source_quote: Part of the hall is used as a food preparation and storage area, containing stocks of dried and fresh fungi, dried fruits, cheeses, preserved meat, and a few clay jars of spices.

subject: mess hall
fact: The mess hall is a cave with four circular zurkhwood tables, each with five chairs.
source_quote: The cave serves as a gathering and eating place for the drow warriors of the outpost. It has four circular tables carved from zurkhwood, each surrounded by five chairs.

subject: mess hall kitchen area
fact: The mess hall includes a food preparation and storage area with dried fungi, fruits, cheeses, preserved meat, and spices.
source_quote: Part of the hall is used as a food preparation and storage area, containing stocks of dried and fresh fungi, dried fruits, cheeses, preserved meat, and a few clay jars of spices.

subject: pool of water
fact: A pool of water is located below the spider web.
source_quote: Below the spider’s web, he notices a pool of water.

subject: pools of water
fact: Pools of water are the final descent point in the escape route, reached via waterfall or spiderwebs, and serve as the transition to the next leg of the journey.
source_quote: Jorlan smiles, “Use the waterfall to slide down, or jump into the spiderwebs and then jump into the pools of water.”

subject: pool with grey ooze
fact: A pool contains a grey ooze used to process waste.
source_quote: Sethir said there is a grey ooze in the pool. That’s how the waste gets processed.

subject: priestess’s tower
fact: The priestess’s tower’s chamber has walls hung with black mesh resembling a spider’s web, extending from the ceiling to the walls.

subject: prison
fact: The prison is located 100’ in the sky with a direct drop that would be suicidal.
source_quote: the Drow outpost was 100’ in the sky. A direct drop would be suicidal.

subject: prison cell
fact: The prison cell faces a stalactite with a door and two bored Drow beyond it.
source_quote: Across from his prison cell is a stalactite. There is a door, and two very bored Drow are past the door.

subject: prison cell door
fact: There is a door across from Zalthir’s cell with two bored Drow guarding it.
source_quote: There is a door, and two very bored Drow are past the door.

subject: quaggoth barracks

subject: shrine chamber

source_quote: Dark silken mats cover the floor of this circular chamber with a pale web-strand pattern woven through them in silvery thread.

subject: shrine to Lolth
fact: The chamber is a shrine to Lolth, the drow’s spider goddess.
source_quote: This place is a shrine to Lolth, the drow’s spider goddess.

subject: slave pen
fact: The slave pen is a dark, oppressive chamber where prisoners are held, plagued by nightmares and strange phenomena. It is controlled by Ilvara’s polycule and serves as the starting point for the escape plan.
source_quote: Everyone’s sleep in the slave pen is troubled and fitful, filled with strange dreams and disturbing images.

subject: slave pen
fact: The slave pen is where the prisoners sleep and experience troubled dreams.
source_quote: Everyone’s sleep in the slave pen is troubled and fitful...

subject: spider statue height
fact: The spider statue atop the zurkhwood pedestal is 10 feet high.
source_quote: a 10-foot-high sculpted spider at its head

subject: spider web
fact: A spider web is visible below the prison cell.
source_quote: He looks a little bit more carefully and notices a spider web.

subject: spiderwebs
fact: Spiderwebs are part of the escape route, serving as a transition between the waterfall and the water pools, and are implied to be dense and possibly hazardous.
source_quote: Jorlan smiles, “Use the waterfall to slide down, or jump into the spiderwebs and then jump into the pools of water.”

subject: stalactite
fact: A stalactite is located across from Zalthir’s prison cell.
source_quote: Across from his prison cell is a stalactite.

subject: The Lake of Filth
fact: The Lake of Filth is the disposal site for chamber pots collected by Daz’s crew; despite daily deposits of waste, the lake appears unnaturally clean, suggesting magical cleansing or hidden mechanisms; no visible source of purification is observed.
source_quote: They look around and see nothing.

subject: The Priestess’s Tower
fact: The Priestess’s Tower is a circular, subterranean chamber serving as the center of Lolth worship and Ilvara’s command; its floor is covered in dark silken mats with pale web-strand patterns; the center holds a zurkhwood pedestal with a 10-foot-tall sculpted spider idol whose eight eyes are polished jet; the chamber contains a shrine to Lolth, a black-stained zurkhwood chest, and a divan-like bed.
source_quote: The eight 'eyes' of the spider statue are eight pieces of polished jet — four small ones worth five gp each and four larger ones worth ten gp each.

subject: The Quaggoth Barracks
fact: The Quaggoth Barracks is a northern cave used as living quarters for quaggoths; it is noted by Daz as a place of rest and low vigilance, suggesting it is not heavily guarded or monitored by the drow.
source_quote: Peeking in, Daz notes one of them resting.

subject: tunnel maze
fact: Characters wander lost through endless mazes of tunnels.
source_quote: characters wander lost through endless mazes of tunnels.

subject: underdark environment
fact: The Underdark has insufficient resources or space for anyone.
source_quote: This is the Underdark. There is not enough resources or space for anyone.

subject: Velkynvelve elevation

source_quote: Drow outpost was 100' in the sky

subject: waterfall
fact: A slippery path leads to the head of the waterfall.
source_quote: he sees buckets and a slippery path leading to the head of the waterfall.

subject: waterfall
fact: The waterfall is one of two escape routes proposed for descending from the prison, to be used by sliding down or jumping into spiderwebs and pools.
source_quote: Jorlan smiles, “Use the waterfall to slide down, or jump into the spiderwebs and then jump into the pools of water.”

subject: winch-and-basket device
fact: A winch-and-basket device is attached to the edge of the barracks platform.
source_quote: Attached to the edge of the barracks platform is a winch-and-basket device consisting of a giant swinging arm that carries a thin cord of strong spider silk.

subject: Winch-and-Basket System
fact: The winch-and-basket system is a mechanical cargo lift suspended in the air; it consists of a giant swinging arm, a thin cord of strong spider silk, multiple pulleys, and a hand-cranked horizontal spool; it carries a heavy woven basket used to transport goods and prisoners across a chasm; it is operated by Balok and controlled by stoppers and signals from below.
source_quote: Attached to the edge of the barracks platform is a winch-and-basket device consisting of a giant swinging arm that carries a thin cord of strong spider silk.

source_quote: You will clean and unload. If you steal anything, then there will be consequences.

subject: Buppido
fact: Buppido is a derro who believes himself to be a divine entity or a god; he projects his thoughts, demands collaboration, and orchestrates escape plans under the guise of a 'divine plan'; his insanity is recognized by Thorin and others, yet his influence persists as he manipulates prisoners into pledging their lives to his cause.
source_quote: Buppido projected his mind: 'The Divine plan says we must collaborate and share information.' ... 'The divine plan requires that you create a distraction while I escape.'

subject: Buppido
fact: Buppido is a derro who claims to follow a divine plan and believes he is a god or represents one.
source_quote: Buppido speaks, or instead projects his mind, “The Divine plan says we must collaborate and share information.” ... Daz learns from the cleric that Buppido thinks he is some kind of god, or he is a god.

subject: Buppido
fact: Buppido is a gnome who reveals Gracklstugh as the intended destination after escape, and mocks the group’s indecision by suggesting they must explain everything to the newcomers.

subject: Daz

source_quote: The voice speaks in undercommon... Another Drow points to Zalthir, Buppido, Jimjar, and Eldeth. Another Drow points at Daz, Sarith, and Stool. A Drow appears and points at Shuushar, Topsy, Turvy, and Gyrgum.

source_quote: As Grygum walks towards the mess hall... Gyrgum has a peculiar expression... As Gyrgum, with theatrical flair, tosses ingredients into the air... Gyrgum notices a knife and tries to steal it.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum is repeatedly referred to as the prisoner who cooks for the Drow, despite the spelling variation from Gyrgum.
source_quote: As Grygum walks towards the mess hall... As the basket comes up, he notices Grygum entering a cave.

subject: Guldor
fact: Guldor informs Daz that they dispose of filth in the lake and clean the buckets.
source_quote: Guldor explains that they collect the filth from each tower in a bucket and then take the bucket to the lake, where they dispose of it and clean the filth.

subject: Guldor
fact: Guldor is a prisoner assigned to clean chamber pots; he is present at the mess hall and sits with Jaezred and Kalannar; he notices Gyrgum attempting to steal a knife and takes it, delivering a clear threat; he is familiar with the consequences of theft and enforces discipline among prisoners.
source_quote: They will do awful things to you if you steal a knife.

subject: Guldor
fact: Guldor is assigned the dirty job of cleaning chamber pots.
source_quote: Oh dear, Guldor has the dirty job of cleaning chamber pots.

subject: Guldor
fact: Guldor notices Gyrgum trying to steal a knife.
source_quote: Guldor notices and Grygum explains that he is just trying to sharpen the knife.

subject: Guldor
fact: Guldor sits at the table with Jaezred and Kalannar in the mess hall.
source_quote: Guldor sits with them.

subject: Guldor
fact: Guldor warns Daz he will be down before they can run if they try anything.
source_quote: Goldur informs Daz that he will be down before they can run if they try any funny business.

subject: Gyrgum
fact: Gyrgum asks where the group will find safety after escape, prompting Eldeth’s grim observation about the Underdark’s nature.
source_quote: Gyrgum asks, “Where will we find safety?”

subject: Gyrgum
fact: Gyrgum asks where they will find safety.
source_quote: Gyrgum asks, “Where will we find safety?”

subject: Gyrgum
fact: Gyrgum asks, 'Where will we find safety?'
source_quote: Gyrgum asks, "Where will we find safety?"

subject: Gyrgum
fact: Gyrgum does not understand undercommon.
source_quote: The voice speaks in undercommon—a language Gyrgum doesn’t understand.

subject: Gyrgum
fact: Gyrgum has a peculiar expression when Buppido says the word 'divine'.
source_quote: Gyrgum has a peculiar expression as Buppido says the word divine.

subject: Gyrgum
fact: Gyrgum has learned not to worry about how much time has passed.
source_quote: From his time as a prisoner the last time, he’s learned not to worry about how much time has passed.

subject: Gyrgum
fact: Gyrgum is a prisoner who does not speak Undercommon but relies on others to translate; he is assigned to cook with Shuushar, Topsy, and Turvy under Imbros's command; he attempts to steal a knife and is warned of severe consequences by Guldor and Shuushar; he is aware that Shuushar omits many details in translation.
source_quote: I don’t speak Undercommon, but he used many more words.

subject: Gyrgum
fact: Gyrgum is an orc chef whose theatrical cooking has become legendary among the prisoners; his skill is so extraordinary that even Shuushar suggests his cooking might be mistaken for divine, and he is now being observed by drow soldiers who are entertained by his performances.
source_quote: Shuushar cautioned the orc, 'If you were to show this cooking to my people, they might imagine a god like you.'

subject: Gyrgum
fact: Gyrgum is assigned to cooking duties with Shuushar, Topsy, and Turvy.
source_quote: Then, at last, it’s Gyrgum’s turn. A Drow appears and points at Shuushar, Topsy, Turvy, and Gyrgum.

subject: Gyrgum
fact: Gyrgum is worried about being led by the Drow with Ront and Prince Derendil.
source_quote: He is worried.

subject: Gyrgum
fact: Gyrgum realizes he is not a great cook but can put on a great show.
source_quote: he realizes that he’s not a great cook and that many ingredients are unfamiliar, but he can put on a great show.

subject: Gyrgum
fact: Gyrgum returns to the kitchen on the next day with six Drow soldiers present.
source_quote: The next day, Gyrgum goes to the kitchen again. This time, six Drow soldiers are present.

subject: Gyrgum
fact: Gyrgum thinks not speaking Undercommon is awkward but manageable because others can translate.
source_quote: Not speaking undercommon is awkward, but then again, understanding the language of your captors may be a problem. And anyway, I’ve got plenty of folks around me who can translate.

subject: Gyrgum
fact: Gyrgum wonders how much time has passed since his last imprisonment.
source_quote: “How much time has passed?” he wonders.

subject: Gyrgum
fact: Gyrgum wonders how to steal a knife again.
source_quote: The orc is pleased but wonders how to steal a knife.

subject: Ilvara
fact: Ilvara is a drow leader who maintains control over the group through her polycule hierarchy. She has discarded Jorlan and elevated Shoor, and is implied to hoard all loot, including the prisoners' belongings.
source_quote: Thorin thinks for a moment, “I know where our stuff is. It’s in the chest in Ilvara’s room. The Drow leader probably keeps all the loot for herself. And if any other Drow had our stuff, they would taunt us.”

subject: Ilvara
fact: Ilvara is the Drow leader who keeps loot in her room.
source_quote: It’s in the chest in Ilvara’s room. The Drow leader probably keeps all the loot for herself.

subject: Ilvara
fact: Ilvara is the high priestess of Lolth and commander of the outpost, who uses a scourge and demands obedience.
source_quote: Ilvara is there. She smiles and has her scourge handy... “I am the high priestess of Lolth and commander. Do not spill any water, do not touch anything, and fill my bath.”

subject: Ilvara
fact: Ilvara is the high priestess of Lolth and commander of the priestess’s tower; she is cold, calculating, and terrifyingly precise in her control over slaves, wielding a scourge and enforcing obedience with threats of violence; her quarters are a shrine-like chamber adorned with dark silken mats, a zurkhwood pedestal, and a sculpted spider idol with jet eyes.
source_quote: Ilvara smiled and had her scourge handy as she flicked it toward her prisoners. 'This is my quarters. I am the high priestess of Lolth and commander. Do not spill any water, do not touch anything, and fill my bath.'

subject: Ilvara
fact: Ilvara smiles and holds her scourge as she speaks to prisoners.
source_quote: Ilvara is there. She smiles and has her scourge handy as she flicks it toward her prisoners.

subject: Ilvara
fact: Ilvara uses a scourge to remind slaves to obey.
source_quote: Mistress Ilvara liked to impress her will with a scourge in hand and remind her slaves that our lives now belong to her.

subject: Ilvara
fact: Ilvara was in charge when Thorin and the others first arrived.
source_quote: Thorin recalls how Ilvara was in charge when they first arrived here.

subject: Ilvara
fact: Thorin notices Ilvara is manic, unlike the typical cold Drow.
source_quote: As Thorin stares at Ilvara some more, he realizes there is something manic about her.

subject: Imbros
fact: Imbros is a Drow overseer who commands Gyrgum, Shuushar, Topsy, and Turvy to cook; his authority is recognized by the prisoners; he is referenced but not directly seen in the scene.
source_quote: Excellent, Imbros wants us to cook.

subject: Imbros
fact: Imbros is a Drow who wants Gyrgum, Shuushar, Topsy, and Turvy to cook.
source_quote: Excellent, Imbros wants us to cook.

subject: Jaezred
fact: Jaezred is a Drow sitting at a table in the mess hall, looking hungry.
source_quote: There are a pair of Drow sitting at a table, looking hungry. Shuushar mutters: “Jaezred and Kalannar”

subject: Jimjar
fact: Jimjar asks if anyone wants to bet on who dies first if they fall.
source_quote: Wanna bet on who would die first when we splat on the ground?

subject: Jimjar
fact: Jimjar asks, “Who wants to bet on which path the new guys will want to go? Will they go with the myconid kid? The enlightened kuo-toan? The Destiny Weilding Derro? Or trust the two deep gnomes?”
source_quote: Jimjar adds, “Who wants to bet on which path the new guys will want to go? Will they go with the myconid kid? The enlightened kuo-toan? The Destiny Weilding Derro? Or trust the two deep gnomes?”

subject: Jimjar
fact: Jimjar bets on which path the new guys will choose.
source_quote: Jimjar adds, “Who wants to bet on which path the new guys will want to go? Will they go with the myconid kid? The enlightened kuo-toan? The Destiny Weilding Derro? Or trust the two deep gnomes?”

subject: Jimjar
fact: Jimjar is a derro who wagers on which escape route the newcomers will choose, listing potential influences: the myconid, the kuo-toan, the Destiny Weilding Derro, or the two deep gnomes.
source_quote: Jimjar adds, “Who wants to bet on which path the new guys will want to go? Will they go with the myconid kid? The enlightened kuo-toan? The Destiny Weilding Derro? Or trust the two deep gnomes?”

subject: Jimjar
fact: Jimjar is a prisoner who constantly tries to make bets about the dangers of the outpost; he speculates on who will die first when falling, how many buckets will be filled, and how many times the basket will be dropped; he is assigned to the winch crew with Zalthir and others; he mutters darkly about the risks and engages others in morbid wagers.
source_quote: Wanna bet on who would die first when we splat on the ground?

subject: Jimjar
fact: Jimjar is a prisoner who repeatedly tries to make bets about the winch operations and escape routes.
source_quote: Jimjar, next to him, mutters, “Wanna bet on who would die first when we splat on the ground?” ... Jimjar again tries to make a bet... Jimjar adds, “Who wants to bet on which path the new guys will want to go?”

subject: Jimjar
fact: Jimjar is assigned to cargo-loading duties.
source_quote: The next Drow appears and points to Zalthir, Buppido, Jimjar, and Eldeth.

subject: Jimjar
fact: Jimjar mutters, “Wanna bet on who would die first when we splat on the ground?”
source_quote: Jimjar, next to him, mutters, “Wanna bet on who would die first when we splat on the ground?”

subject: Jimjar
fact: Jimjar says, “Wanna get in on some juicy action on how many times they’ll do this?”
source_quote: Jimjar shouts, “Wanna get in on some juicy action on how many times they’ll do this?”

subject: Jimjar
fact: Jimjar tries to make a bet: “Wanna get some action on how many buckets will be filled?”
source_quote: Jimjar again tries to make a bet, “Wanna get some action on how many buckets will be filled?”

subject: Jorlan
fact: Jorlan asks Thorin if he would try to escape if given the chance.
source_quote: Jorlan turns to Thorin, “If I made it possible for you to escape, would you try?”

subject: Jorlan
fact: Jorlan is a former leader of Ilvara’s polycule, disfigured by acid and discarded after losing a finger. He offers to help the prisoners escape to embarrass Shoor and make Ilvara regret her mistake. He opens the prison door, creates a distraction, and guides them toward the armory.
source_quote: Jorlan says, “That’s Jorlan. He used to be the number one, but after he got hit with acid, his face was disfigured and he lost a finger, Ilvara’s dropped him, and now Shoor is number one.” Jorlan turns to Thorin, “If I made it possible for you to escape, would you try?”

subject: Jorlan
fact: Jorlan is a former number-one servant of Ilvara who was disfigured by acid and now offers to help the prisoners escape.
source_quote: Sethir says, “That’s Jorlan. He used to be the number one, but after he got hit with acid, his face was disfigured and he lost a finger, Ilvara’s dropped him... Jorlan turns to Thorin, “If I made it possible for you to escape, would you try?”

subject: Jorlan
fact: Jorlan says, “I don’t care if you succeed. I just want you to try. It will make Shoor look ridiculous, and make Ilvara realize what a terrible mistake she’s made. And if you do make a mistake, she’ll be embarrassed and need my help to find you and realize what a mistake she made.”
source_quote: Jorlan says, “I don’t care if you succeed. I just want you to try. It will make Shoor look ridiculous, and make Ilvara realize what a terrible mistake she’s made. And if you do make a mistake, she’ll be embarrassed and need my help to find you and realize what a mistake she made.”

subject: Jorlan
fact: Jorlan says, “I will leave the door to the prison open, create a distraction. The path to the armory will be unguarded. Grab the weapons and flee.”
source_quote: I will leave the door to the prison open, create a distraction. The path to the armory will be unguarded. Grab the weapons and flee.

subject: Jorlan
fact: Jorlan says, “Use the waterfall to slide down, or jump into the spiderwebs and then jump into the pools of water.”
source_quote: Use the waterfall to slide down, or jump into the spiderwebs and then jump into the pools of water.

subject: Kalannar
fact: Kalannar is a Drow sitting at a table in the mess hall, looking hungry.
source_quote: There are a pair of Drow sitting at a table, looking hungry. Shuushar mutters: “Jaezred and Kalannar”

subject: Prince Derendil
fact: Prince Derendil asserts that there is no abolitionist movement among Lolth-worshippers, implying that any aid offered must serve the drow’s own benefit, not the prisoners’ freedom.
source_quote: Prince Derendil explains, “Well we know that there is no abolitionist movement amongst those who worship Lolth. It has to be for his benefit.”

subject: Prince Derendil
fact: Prince Derendil is a deluded Quaggoth to be assigned to daily chores.
source_quote: Ront and Prince Derendil, the deluded Quaggoth, are to follow this Drow.

subject: Prince Derendil
fact: Prince Derendil is a deluded Quaggoth who recalls Ilvara’s greeting and her phrase about accepting fate.
source_quote: Prince Derendil mutters, “ I remember how she greeted me when I arrived. She was robed in silken garments and flanked by two male drow, one of whom had a mass of scars along one side of his face and neck. Mistress Ilvara liked to impress her will with a scourge in hand and remind her slaves that our lives now belong to her. Every time, she would end her pep talks with the phrase - ‘Accept your fate, learn to obey, and you may survive.’”

subject: Prince Derendil
fact: Prince Derendil is a nobleman enslaved in the prison complex; he recalls being greeted by Ilvara in silken garments flanked by scarred drow, and he resists his enslavement, provoking violent threats from Ilvara; he is present during key moments of tension and escape planning.
source_quote: Prince Derendil mutters, 'I remember how she greeted me when I arrived. She was robed in silken garments and flanked by two male drow, one of whom had a mass of scars along one side of his face and neck.'

subject: Prince Derendil
fact: Prince Derendil remembers Ilvara greeting him robed in silken garments with two male drow, one scarred.
source_quote: I remember how she greeted me when I arrived. She was robed in silken garments and flanked by two male drow, one of whom had a mass of scars along one side of his face and neck.

subject: Prince Derendil
fact: Prince Derendil remembers how Ilvara greeted him upon arrival, robed in silken garments and flanked by scarred drow.
source_quote: I remember how she greeted me when I arrived. She was robed in silken garments and flanked by two male drow, one of whom had a mass of scars along one side of his face and neck. Mistress Ilvara liked to impress her will with a scourge in hand and remind her slaves that our lives now belong to her. Every time, she would end her pep talks with the phrase - ‘Accept your fate, learn to obey, and you may survive.’

subject: Prince Derendil
fact: Prince Derendil says there is no abolitionist movement among Lolth worshippers.
source_quote: Prince Derendil explains, “Well we know that there is no abolitionist movement amongst those who worship Lolth. It has to be for his benefit.”

subject: Ront
fact: Ront is a Quaggoth who is led by Beremil to carry water.
source_quote: Ront and Prince Derendil, the deluded Quaggoth, are to follow this Drow.

subject: Ront
fact: Ront is a deluded Quaggoth referred to as 'the Prince'; he is seen filling buckets of water alongside Thorin; he is under the command of a Drow and participates in daily labor; his delusion is acknowledged by the prisoners.
source_quote: Ront and Prince Derendil, the deluded Quaggoth, are to follow this Drow.

subject: Ront
fact: Ront is to follow a Drow for daily chores.
source_quote: Ront and Prince Derendil, the deluded Quaggoth, are to follow this Drow.

subject: Sarith
fact: Sarith is a member of the group who confirms Zalthir’s observation about debts and repayment, nodding in agreement to the system of wagers and future collection.
source_quote: Sarith nods.

subject: Sarith
fact: Sarith is a prisoner assigned with Daz and Stool to clean chamber pots.
source_quote: Another Drow points at Daz, Sarith, and Stool.

subject: Sarith
fact: Sarith is pointed out by a Drow for chamber pot cleaning duties.
source_quote: Another Drow points at Daz, Sarith, and Stool.

subject: Sarith
fact: Sarith nods in acknowledgment.
source_quote: Sarith nods.

subject: Sarith
fact: Sarith nods in response to the wager offer.
source_quote: Sarith nods.

subject: Sethir
fact: Sethir is a member of Ilvara’s polycule who identifies Jorlan to Thorin.
source_quote: Sethir says, “That’s Jorlan. He used to be the number one, but after he got hit with acid, his face was disfigured and he lost a finger, Ilvara’s dropped him, and now Shoor is number one.”

subject: Sethir
fact: Sethir is a member of Ilvara’s polycule who provides key information about Jorlan’s fall from grace and the current hierarchy. He also mentions the presence of a grey ooze in the pool used for waste processing.
source_quote: Sethir says, “That’s Jorlan. He used to be the number one, but after he got hit with acid, his face was disfigured and he lost a finger, Ilvara’s dropped him, and now Shoor is number one.” Daz wakes up and remembers, “Right, Sethir said there is a grey ooze in the pool. That’s how the waste gets processed.”

subject: Sethir
fact: Sethir is referenced as having mentioned a grey ooze in the pool.
source_quote: Sethir said there is a grey ooze in the pool.

subject: Sethir
fact: Sethir tells Thorin that Jorlan used to be number one but was disfigured by acid and demoted.
source_quote: Sethir says, “That’s Jorlan. He used to be the number one, but after he got hit with acid, his face was disfigured and he lost a finger, Ilvara’s dropped him, and now Shoor is number one.”

subject: Shoor
fact: Shoor is the current leader of Ilvara’s polycule, having replaced Jorlan after his disfigurement. He is the target of Jorlan’s sabotage plan, intended to make him look ridiculous.
source_quote: Sethir says, “That’s Jorlan. He used to be the number one, but after he got hit with acid, his face was disfigured and he lost a finger, Ilvara’s dropped him, and now Shoor is number one.”

subject: Shoor
fact: Shoor is the current number-one servant of Ilvara, replacing Jorlan.
source_quote: Sethir says, “... now Shoor is number one.”

subject: Shuushar
fact: Shuushar has chosen not to repeat offensive words as part of his spiritual balance.
source_quote: As part of my attempt to find spiritual balance and cope with the madness of my race, I have chosen not to repeat offensive words.

subject: Shuushar
fact: Shuushar is a Kuo-Toan who translates Drow speech for Gyrgum and cautions him about cooking being a better distraction.
source_quote: The Kuo-Toan Shuushar the Awakened notices and tells him to relax... Shuushar translates, “Can you cook? That would be a better distraction.”

subject: Shuushar
fact: Shuushar is a kuo-toan who insists the direct path leads through Menzoberranzan, requiring a detour to Darklake to share enlightenment with his people before proceeding.
source_quote: Shuushar objects, “Yes, but the direct path is through Menzoberranzan. We will have to go to Darklake first, and we must visit my people to share the enlightenment! From there, the path is good.”

subject: Shuushar
fact: Shuushar is an Awakened Kuo-Toan who communicates through gestures and partial translation; he claims to have chosen spiritual balance by avoiding offensive language but translates every insult; he smiles in a way that may be a smile; he is assigned to cook with Gyrgum and the others under Imbros; he mediates between prisoners and Drow, and attempts to orchestrate distractions for food theft.
source_quote: I have chosen not to repeat offensive words.

subject: Shuushar
fact: Shuushar mutters, “Jaezred and Kalannar” when identifying the Drow.
source_quote: Shuushar mutters: “Jaezred and Kalannar”

subject: Shuushar
fact: Shuushar objects, “Yes, but the direct path is through Menzoberranzan. We will have to go to Darklake first, and we must visit my people to share the enlightenment! From there, the path is good.”
source_quote: Shuushar objects, “Yes, but the direct path is through Menzoberranzan. We will have to go to Darklake first, and we must visit my people to share the enlightenment! From there, the path is good.”

subject: Shuushar the Awakened
fact: Shuushar explains that the Drow soldiers heard about Gyrgum’s cooking and wanted to experience it.
source_quote: Shuushar explains that they heard about his fantastic show and wanted to experience it themselves.

subject: Shuushar the Awakened
fact: Shuushar objects and says they must go to Darklake first to visit his people and share enlightenment.
source_quote: Shuushar objects, “Yes, but the direct path is through Menzoberranzan. We will have to go to Darklake first, and we must visit my people to share the enlightenment! From there, the path is good.”

subject: Shuushar the Awakened
fact: Shuushar seems excited about Gyrgum’s cooking but cautions him.
source_quote: Even Shuushar seems excited, although he cautions the orc, “If you were to show this cooking to my people, they might imagine a god like you.”

subject: Shuushar the Awakened
fact: Shuushar tells Gyrgum he doesn’t speak undercommon.
source_quote: “I don’t speak undercommon.”

subject: Shuushar the Awakened
fact: Shuushar the Awakened tells Gyrgum to relax about the chores.
source_quote: the Kuo-Toan Shuushar the Awakened notices and tells him to relax

subject: Shuushar the Awakened
fact: Shuushar translates every insult the Drow uses, omitting offensive words.
source_quote: I have chosen not to repeat offensive words.” And then Shuushar proceeds to translate every insult the drow used.

subject: Shuushar the Awakened
fact: Shuushar translates that stealing a knife will result in awful things being done to Gyrgum.
source_quote: Shuushar translates, “They will do awful things to you if you steal a knife.”

subject: Stool
fact: Stool is a myconid who objects to the plan to go through the great circle, asserting his people’s connection to the area and opposing routes that endanger them.
source_quote: Stool objects, “No to the great circle! My people!”

subject: Stool
fact: Stool is a prisoner who spreads spores to create a group mind among the prisoners and objects to going to Gracklstugh.
source_quote: The stool is happy to be talking to everyone and has spread his spores so that everyone in the prison cell is in a group mind. ... Stool objects, “No to the great circle! My people!”

subject: Stool
fact: Stool is pointed out by a Drow for chamber pot cleaning duties.
source_quote: Another Drow points at Daz, Sarith, and Stool.

subject: Stool
fact: Stool objects to going to Gracklstugh and says, “No to the great circle! My people!”
source_quote: Stool objects, “No to the great circle! My people!”

subject: Stool
fact: Stool spreads spores in the prison cell, creating a group mind.
source_quote: Stool is happy to be talking to everyone and has spread his spores so that everyone in the prison cell is in a group mind.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin believes the Drow leader keeps all the loot for herself.
source_quote: The Drow leader probably keeps all the loot for herself.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin corrects Buppido, saying, “We escape?”
source_quote: Thorin corrects him, “We escape?”

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin is a Quaggoth referred to alongside Ront as 'the Prince'; he is seen filling buckets of water; he is under Drow command and participates in labor; his identity as a deluded figure is noted by the prisoners.
source_quote: As the four prisoners enter the basket, Balok pulls a stopper, and the basket flies over the chasm. The two quahogs let it drop. ... Jimjar turns to anyone, 'Wanna get some action on how many buckets will be filled?'

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin is a dwarf raised by Giants who observes the drow with skepticism, noting Ilvara's manic behavior and questioning Buppido’s delusions of divinity; he has pledged his sword and life to protect Buppido in exchange for the promise of collective escape.
source_quote: Thorin corrected Buppido: 'We escape?' ... 'Well, how else will we protect you so that you can fulfill the divine plan?'

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin is a dwarf who observes the waterfall, speaks with Jorlan, and participates in escape planning.
source_quote: Thorin is standing on the other side of the bridge south of the prison cell... Thorin remembers all these free-for-all conversations... Thorin connected to his friends via the spores... Thorin is satisfied.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin is a dwarf who recalls chaotic conversations from his youth, and is surprised when a member of Ilvara’s polycule brings food. He connects to his companions via spores to question Jorlan’s motives, and ultimately accepts the escape plan after Jorlan’s assurances.
source_quote: Thorin connected to his friends via the spores and asked, “How do we know that he isn’t here to entrap us?” Thorin is satisfied. “What’s the plan?”

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin is surprised to see Jorlan bring food.
source_quote: he is surprised to see a member of Ilvara’s polycule bring it. Sethir says, “That’s Jorlan.”

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin knows where their stuff is: in the chest in Ilvara’s room, and the Drow leader probably keeps all the loot for herself.
source_quote: I know where our stuff is. It’s in the chest in Ilvara’s room. The Drow leader probably keeps all the loot for herself. And if any other Drow had our stuff, they would taunt us.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin recalls how Ilvara was in charge when they first arrived.
source_quote: Thorin recalls how Ilvara was in charge when they first arrived here.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin remembers free-for-all conversations from his youth, with everyone shouting and not listening.
source_quote: Thorin remembers all these free-for-all conversations when he was younger. Everyone was talking over everyone, everyone was shouting, and everyone was not listening.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin remembers that their stuff is in the chest in Ilvara’s room.
source_quote: I know where our stuff is. It’s in the chest in Ilvara’s room.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin says if any other Drow had their stuff, they would taunt them.
source_quote: And if any other Drow had our stuff, they would taunt us.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin stands on the bridge south of the prison cell.
source_quote: Thorin is standing on the other side of the bridge south of the prison cell.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin thinks, 'I know where our stuff is. It’s in the chest in Ilvara’s room. The Drow leader probably keeps all the loot for herself. And if any other Drow had our stuff, they would taunt us.'
source_quote: Thorin thinks for a moment, "I know where our stuff is. It’s in the chest in Ilvara’s room. The Drow leader probably keeps all the loot for herself. And if any other Drow had our stuff, they would taunt us."

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin thinks, “Something for later.” when seeing the spider statue’s jet eyes.
source_quote: “Something for later.”

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin turns to the Drow and says their deal is accepted.
source_quote: The dwarf turns to the Drow and says, “Your deal is accepted. When?”

subject: Topsy
fact: Topsy is a deep gnome who advocates for Blingdenstone as the escape route, citing a known exit from the Underdark there.
source_quote: Topsy says, “We should go to Blingdenstone. I know there is a way out of the Underdark from there.”

subject: Topsy
fact: Topsy is a deep gnome who whispers to Turvy and later steals knives during Gyrgum’s cooking show.
source_quote: Topsy and Turvy whisper to each other... Topsy and Turvy steal several knives.

subject: Zalthir

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir is a dragonborn monk detailed to the winch, tasked with cleaning up after Daz, Stool, and Sarith, and now uses the cleaning to examine how to damage the winch to aid escape. He is focused on spider silk's role in the mechanism and considers fire-breathing as a means to cut ropes. He took a piece of rope to test its resistance later.
source_quote: But I breathe fire, and fire breathing is a simpler way to cut a rope… He takes a small piece of rope to test its resistance later.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir is a dragonborn monk who notices a spider web, a pool of water, and pockets a piece of paper.
source_quote: Zalthir notices a spider web. Below the spider’s web, he notices a pool of water. ... He pockets the paper.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir is a prisoner who notices environmental details such as spider webs, water pools, and a paper with names of debtors; he pockets the paper after noticing it in the basket; he observes Elspeth taking a comb and realizes he has little use for it; he is assigned to clean and unload cargo with Balok's group; he is aware of the lethal drop from the outpost and the danger of the winch system.
source_quote: It’s unclear where, which city, what favor, and why.

fact: Zalthir is assigned to the winch again on the next day.
source_quote: The dragonborn monk is once again detailed to the winch.

source_quote: Thorin thinks for a moment, “I know where our stuff is. It’s in the chest in Ilvara’s room. The Drow leader probably keeps all the loot for herself. And if any other Drow had our stuff, they would taunt us.”

subject: Ilvara’s Scourge

source_quote: The eight “eyes” of the spider statue are eight pieces of polished jet — four small ones worth five gp each and four larger ones worth ten gp each.

subject: Knife
fact: A knife is present in the kitchen area; Gyrgum attempts to steal it to sharpen it; Guldor takes it and delivers a clear threat of punishment; it is a tool of utility and potential rebellion.
source_quote: They will do awful things to you if you steal a knife.

subject: knife

source_quote: a pair of heavy silver candlesticks worth 25 gp each

source_quote: four small ones worth five gp each

subject: spider silk
fact: Spider silk is used in the winch mechanism, passing through the gears and basket. Zalthir examines it as a potential point of sabotage.
source_quote: The two things that attract his attention are using spider silk to hold the basket and the winch and gears that the spider silk goes through.

subject: spider silk

subject: spider silk cord
